feature_protocol: generated denormalized 262-D per-person global representation; pair inputs concatenate two people; 150 valid frames
protocol_note: Group2 alignment is the primary RAG-sensitive diagnostic. Text-motion R-precision is computed across this fixed set and is not the paper's reported multi-group score.

RAG_effect_without_guidance.note: Per-scene rank changes against each condition's own 120-text/120-motion set; text queries differ under RAG.

RAG_effect_with_guidance.note: Per-scene rank changes against each condition's own 120-text/120-motion set; text queries differ under RAG.
